fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a suspicious command line execution that invokes PowerShell with reference to an AppData folder
fields.name: PowerShell Script Run in AppData
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "powershell.exe" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\powershell" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\pwsh" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "pwsh.exe") and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "/c " and tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\AppData\\") and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "Local\\" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "Roaming\\"))))
